headquarter.zh: 把總部設在（常用被動 be headquartered in）

ex.en: The company is headquartered in Taipei.
ex.zh: 這家公司總部設在台北。

ex.en: Many tech firms are headquartered in California.
ex.zh: 許多科技公司的總部設在加州。

headquarter.en: to have the main office of a company in a place

ex.en: There was a different kind of atmosphere in the headquarters.
ex.zh: 總部裡的氣氛不太一樣。

ex.en: I have a meeting at headquarters tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天要去總公司開會。

headquarter.en: the main office of a company or organization

ex.en: The government plans to spend more on healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府計畫增加醫療保健支出。

ex.en: She works in the healthcare industry.
ex.zh: 她在醫療產業工作。

healthcare.en: the services that look after people's physical and mental health

ex.en: Tom is hesitant to visit Mary in the hospital.
ex.zh: 湯姆對要不要去醫院探望瑪麗有點猶豫。

ex.en: Why did he remain hesitant?
ex.zh: 他為什麼還是猶豫不決？

ex.en: Don't be hesitant to ask questions.
ex.zh: 有問題不要猶豫，儘管問。

hesitant.en: slow to act because you are not sure

ex.en: Tom is wearing headphones.
ex.zh: 湯姆戴著耳機。

ex.en: Everybody was wearing headphones.
ex.zh: 每個人都戴著耳機。

ex.en: I always wear headphones on the subway.
ex.zh: 我搭捷運時總是戴著耳機。

headphone.en: a pair of small speakers that you wear over your ears

ex.en: The heater is broken.
ex.zh: 暖氣機壞了。

ex.en: The heater doesn't work.
ex.zh: 暖氣機不能用了。

ex.en: Could you turn on the heater? It's freezing.
ex.zh: 可以開一下暖氣嗎？好冷喔。

heater.en: a machine that makes a room or thing warm

ex.en: It is dangerous to ride a motorbike without a helmet.
ex.zh: 騎機車不戴安全帽很危險。

ex.en: You have to wear a helmet to protect your head.
ex.zh: 你得戴安全帽來保護頭部。

ex.en: She felt much safer once she’d put her helmet on.
ex.zh: 她一戴上安全帽，就覺得安全多了。

helmet.en: a hard hat that protects your head

ex.en: We, ACME Ltd., hereby announce that we will resist with all our strength this hostile takeover.
ex.zh: 本公司 ACME 有限公司特此聲明，我們將全力抵制這項惡意收購。

ex.en: I hereby resign from my position as manager.
ex.zh: 我特此辭去經理一職。

ex.en: You are hereby notified of the change in policy.
ex.zh: 特此通知您政策有所變更。

hereby.en: by means of this statement, used in formal speech or writing

ex.en: Without the slightest hesitation, he sold his own car.
ex.zh: 他毫不猶豫地把自己的車賣了。

ex.en: After some hesitation, he laid the book on the desk.
ex.zh: 猶豫了一會兒之後，他把書放在桌上。

ex.en: She accepted the job offer without hesitation.
ex.zh: 她毫不猶豫地接受了這份工作。

hesitation.en: a pause before doing something because you are not sure

ex.en: Try to eat a healthful diet.
ex.zh: 盡量吃得健康。

ex.en: Walking is a healthful habit.
ex.zh: 散步是有益健康的習慣。

healthful.en: good for your body and health

ex.en: The cat got through the hedge.
ex.zh: 貓從樹籬鑽了過去。

ex.en: We need to trim the hedge this weekend.
ex.zh: 我們這週末得修剪樹籬。

hedge.en: a line of bushes planted as a fence

ex.en: Gold is often seen as a hedge against inflation.
ex.zh: 黃金常被視為對抗通膨的避險工具。

ex.en: Many people buy property as a hedge against rising prices.
ex.zh: 很多人買房子來對抗物價上漲。

hedge.en: something that protects you from losing money

ex.en: The company hedges against currency risk.
ex.zh: 公司對匯率風險進行避險。

ex.en: Investors hedge their bets by buying different assets.
ex.zh: 投資人買進不同的資產來分散風險。

hedge.en: to protect yourself from losing money

ex.en: They were rescued by helicopter.
ex.zh: 他們被直升機救起。

ex.en: The government transported goods to the island by helicopter.
ex.zh: 政府用直升機把物資運到那座島上。

ex.en: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
ex.zh: 我看到一架直升機從頭頂飛過。

helicopter.en: an aircraft with large blades on top that lets it go straight up

ex.en: He is the heir to a large fortune.
ex.zh: 他是一大筆財產的繼承人。

ex.en: She is seen as the natural heir to the CEO.
ex.zh: 大家都認為她是執行長的不二接班人。

heir.en: a person who will receive money or a title when someone dies

ex.en: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
ex.zh: 他剛發表了一系列有趣的文章。

ex.en: "This is what I was looking for!" he exclaimed.
ex.zh: 「這就是我在找的東西！」他大叫。

ex.en: He works in the marketing department.
ex.zh: 他在行銷部工作。

he.en: used to talk about a man or boy already mentioned

ex.en: What would you like to do while you're here?
ex.zh: 你在這裡的時候想做什麼？

ex.en: Do you know of any good restaurant near here?
ex.zh: 你知道這附近有什麼好餐廳嗎？

ex.en: Would you mind my staying here for some time?
ex.zh: 你介意我在這裡待一會兒嗎？

here.zh: here is / here you are：（遞東西時）這是…、給你

ex.en: Here you are, your boarding pass.
ex.zh: 給您，這是您的登機證。

ex.en: Here is your change, sir.
ex.zh: 先生，這是找您的錢。

here.en: used when giving something to someone

ex.en: I can hear you, but I can't see you.
ex.zh: 我聽得到你，但看不到你。

ex.en: Did you hear that noise?
ex.zh: 你有聽到那個聲音嗎？

hear.en: to notice sounds with your ears

ex.en: Hearing the news, he jumped out of his chair.
ex.zh: 他一聽到消息就從椅子上跳了起來。

ex.en: We hadn't so much as heard of her name.
ex.zh: 我們連她的名字都沒聽過。

hear.en: to be told news or information

ex.en: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
ex.zh: 期待很快收到你的回音。

ex.en: Have you heard from Amy lately?
ex.zh: 你最近有艾咪的消息嗎？

hear.en: to get a letter, call or message from someone

ex.en: Cover your head when you are in the sun.
ex.zh: 在太陽底下要遮住頭。

ex.en: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
ex.zh: 護士輕輕地幫我的頭纏上繃帶。

head.en: the part of the body above the neck that has the face and brain

ex.en: She is the head of the marketing department.
ex.zh: 她是行銷部的主管。

ex.en: The head of the company will visit us next week.
ex.zh: 公司負責人下週會來拜訪我們。

head.en: the person in charge of a group or organization

ex.en: Tom told me that he was headed home.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我說他要回家了。

ex.en: Where are you heading?
ex.zh: 你要去哪裡？

head.en: to go in a certain direction

ex.en: Amy heads the new project team.
ex.zh: Amy 負責帶領新的專案團隊。

ex.en: The committee is headed by our CEO.
ex.zh: 這個委員會由我們的執行長領導。

head.en: to lead a group or organization

ex.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
ex.zh: 為了健康，我戒菸了。

ex.en: Parents have responsibilities to look to their children's health.
ex.zh: 父母有責任照顧孩子的健康。

ex.en: He did it at the expense of his health.
ex.zh: 他犧牲自己的健康完成了這件事。

health.en: the condition of your body and mind

ex.en: Our company offers health insurance to all employees.
ex.zh: 我們公司為所有員工提供健康保險。

ex.en: She works in public health.
ex.zh: 她在公共衛生領域工作。

health.en: the field of keeping people well and treating illness

ex.en: He died of a heart attack on the stage.
ex.zh: 他在舞台上心臟病發過世。

ex.en: Exercise is good for your heart.
ex.zh: 運動對心臟有益。

heart.en: the organ in your chest that pumps blood

ex.en: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
ex.zh: 我打從心底感謝你。

ex.en: She has a kind heart.
ex.zh: 她心地善良。

heart.en: the place in a person where feelings and emotions are felt

ex.en: I learned English words by heart all day yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天一整天都在背英文單字。

ex.en: I know the song by heart.
ex.zh: 我會背這首歌。

heart.en: so that you can say it from memory

ex.en: The hotel is in the heart of the city.
ex.zh: 飯店位於市中心。

ex.en: Let's get to the heart of the problem.
ex.zh: 我們直接切入問題的核心吧。

heart.en: the middle or most important part of a place

ex.en: I can't lift a suitcase heavier than 30 kilos.
ex.zh: 我提不動超過三十公斤的行李箱。

ex.en: The bag was too heavy for me to move.
ex.zh: 那個袋子太重了，我搬不動。

ex.en: Which is the heavier of the two?
ex.zh: 兩者之中哪一個比較重？

heavy.zh: 大量的、嚴重的（交通、雨等）

ex.en: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
ex.zh: 大部分死於吸菸的人並不是重度吸菸者。

ex.en: Traffic is heavy during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段交通很壅塞。

ex.en: Heavy rain is expected this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午預計會有大雨。

heavy.en: larger, stronger or more than usual

ex.en: I can't put up with the heat any longer.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了這種熱了。

ex.en: My father does not like the heat of summer.
ex.zh: 我爸爸不喜歡夏天的炎熱。

ex.en: The heat in the kitchen was unbearable.
ex.zh: 廚房裡熱得受不了。

heat.en: the quality of being hot, or very hot weather

ex.en: Heating water does not change its chemical composition.
ex.zh: 把水加熱不會改變它的化學成分。

ex.en: No matter how cold it is outside, the rooms are comfortably heated.
ex.zh: 不管外面多冷，房間裡都很溫暖舒適。

ex.en: Can you heat up the soup for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把湯熱一下嗎？

heat.en: to make something warm or hot

ex.en: I'm cold. Would you mind turning the heating on?
ex.zh: 我好冷，你介意開暖氣嗎？

ex.en: We had a heated discussion about it.
ex.zh: 我們針對這件事進行了激烈的討論。

heat.en: warmth from a system in a building, or strong feeling and excitement

ex.en: When learning Chinese, pinyin is very helpful for beginners.
ex.zh: 學中文時，拼音對初學者很有幫助。

ex.en: It would be helpful if you could do that for me.
ex.zh: 如果你能幫我做那件事，會很有幫助。

ex.en: Thank you, your advice was very helpful.
ex.zh: 謝謝，你的建議很有幫助。

helpful.zh: 樂於助人的、幫得上忙的

ex.en: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
ex.zh: 他也許很聰明，但不太幫得上忙。

ex.en: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful.
ex.zh: 飯店員工親切又樂於助人。

ex.en: The road to hell is paved with good intentions.
ex.zh: 通往地獄的路是由善意鋪成的。

ex.en: I also think 'living hell' is putting it too strongly.
ex.zh: 我也覺得說成「人間地獄」有點太誇張了。

ex.en: Working there was hell.
ex.zh: 在那裡工作簡直是地獄。

hell.en: a place of punishment after death, or a very unpleasant situation

ex.en: Hence, we have to take care of ourselves.
ex.zh: 因此，我們必須照顧好自己。

ex.en: He did everything to be able to survive, hence he never wants to talk about it.
ex.zh: 他為了活下來什麼都做了，因此他從來不想談這件事。

ex.en: The product is handmade, hence the high price.
ex.zh: 這項產品是手工製作的，所以價格較高。

ex.en: He dreamed of being a hero.
ex.zh: 他夢想成為英雄。

ex.en: Heroes arise in troubled times.
ex.zh: 亂世出英雄。

hero.en: a person who is admired for being brave or doing something great

ex.en: The hero of the movie is a young doctor.
ex.zh: 這部電影的男主角是一位年輕醫生。

ex.en: In the end, the hero saves the city.
ex.zh: 最後，男主角拯救了這座城市。

hero.en: the main male character in a story or film

ex.en: It has been raining heavily for three hours.
ex.zh: 大雨已經下了三個小時。

ex.en: It was raining heavily when I got up this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上起床時雨下得很大。

ex.en: Bill hates that his father smokes heavily.
ex.zh: 比爾很討厭他爸爸菸抽得很兇。

heavily.en: in large amounts or with great force

ex.en: The company relies heavily on exports.
ex.zh: 這家公司非常依賴出口。

ex.en: The city was heavily damaged by the earthquake.
ex.zh: 這座城市在地震中嚴重受損。

ex.en: My little brother and I are the same height.
ex.zh: 我弟弟和我一樣高。

ex.en: What is the average height of the players?
ex.zh: 選手們的平均身高是多少？

ex.en: The height of the building is 100 meters.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓高 100 公尺。

height.en: how tall a person or thing is

ex.en: Tom is afraid of heights.
ex.zh: 湯姆有懼高症。

ex.en: Something you should know about me is that I'm afraid of heights.
ex.zh: 關於我，有件事你應該知道：我怕高。

ex.en: The hotel is full at the height of summer.
ex.zh: 盛夏時節飯店都客滿。

ex.en: She was at the height of her career.
ex.zh: 她當時正處於事業的巔峰。

height.en: the point of greatest strength or activity

ex.en: I hesitated about which road to take.
ex.zh: 我猶豫著不知道該走哪條路。

ex.en: He walked back and forth in front of the door, hesitating to enter.
ex.zh: 他在門前走來走去，猶豫著要不要進去。

ex.en: She hesitated before answering the question.
ex.zh: 她猶豫了一下才回答問題。

hesitate.en: to pause before doing something because you are not sure

hesitate.zh: don't hesitate to：儘管、別客氣（做某事）

ex.en: Please don't hesitate to contact me if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請儘管與我聯絡。

ex.en: Don't hesitate to ask for help.
ex.zh: 需要幫忙的話別客氣。

hesitate.en: used to tell someone they should feel free to do something

ex.en: DNA has the shape of a double helix.
ex.zh: DNA 呈雙螺旋結構。

ex.en: The staircase rises in a helix.
ex.zh: 樓梯呈螺旋狀往上延伸。

helix.en: a shape that curves round and round like a spring

ex.en: Hepatitis B is common in some parts of Asia.
ex.zh: B 型肝炎在亞洲部分地區很常見。

ex.en: You should get vaccinated against hepatitis before the trip.
ex.zh: 出發前你應該先接種肝炎疫苗。

hepatitis.en: a serious disease of the liver

ex.en: Farmers spray herbicide to kill weeds.
ex.zh: 農民噴灑除草劑來除掉雜草。

ex.en: This vegetable was grown without herbicides.
ex.zh: 這種蔬菜種植時沒有使用除草劑。

herbicide.en: a chemical used to kill unwanted plants

ex.en: It has been a hectic week at the office.
ex.zh: 這一週辦公室裡忙得不可開交。

ex.en: My schedule is too hectic to take a vacation right now.
ex.zh: 我現在行程太滿，沒辦法休假。

ex.en: The airport is always hectic before the holidays.
ex.zh: 連假前機場總是一片忙亂。

hectic.en: very busy with a lot to do

ex.en: The newborn calf couldn't catch up with the herd running from the jaguar.
ex.zh: 剛出生的小牛跟不上逃離美洲豹的牛群。

ex.en: A herd of cows was walking across the field.
ex.zh: 一群牛正走過田野。

herd.en: a large group of animals that live and move together

herd.zh: 把……趕在一起、帶領（一群人）

ex.en: The guide herded the tourists onto the bus.
ex.zh: 導遊把遊客趕上巴士。

ex.en: Teachers herded the children into the hall.
ex.zh: 老師們把孩子帶進禮堂。

herd.en: to make a group of people or animals move together

ex.en: Having a slight headache, I went to bed early.
ex.zh: 我有點頭痛，所以早早就上床睡覺了。

ex.en: Tom told us that he had a headache.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟我們說他頭痛。

ex.en: A cup of coffee relieved me of my headache.
ex.zh: 一杯咖啡讓我的頭痛舒緩了。

ex.en: Finding a parking space downtown is a real headache.
ex.zh: 在市區找停車位真的很令人頭痛。

ex.en: The new software has been a headache for everyone.
ex.zh: 新軟體讓每個人都很頭痛。

headache.en: a problem that is difficult and annoying

ex.en: I'm not as healthy as I used to be.
ex.zh: 我已經不像從前那樣健康了。

ex.en: Some of them are healthy, but others are not.
ex.zh: 他們有些人身體健康，有些人不是。

healthy.en: not sick and strong in body

ex.en: I consider fruit to be the healthiest food.
ex.zh: 我認為水果是最健康的食物。

ex.en: Country life is healthier than city life.
ex.zh: 鄉村生活比都市生活健康。

ex.en: Europe is suffering from a record-breaking heat wave.
ex.zh: 歐洲正遭受破紀錄的熱浪侵襲。

ex.en: Stay indoors and drink plenty of water during a heat wave.
ex.zh: 熱浪期間請待在室內並多喝水。

heat wave.en: a period of very hot weather that lasts several days

ex.en: She hesitantly raised her hand to ask a question.
ex.zh: 她遲疑地舉起手想問問題。

ex.en: He answered hesitantly, as if he wasn't sure.
ex.zh: 他遲疑地回答，好像不太確定。

hesitantly.en: in a slow way because you are not sure

ex.en: The survey asked whether participants were heterosexual or not.
ex.zh: 這份調查詢問受訪者是否為異性戀者。

ex.en: They are a heterosexual couple with two children.
ex.zh: 他們是一對異性戀夫妻，有兩個孩子。

heterosexual.en: attracted to people of the opposite sex

ex.en: My grandfather is a bit hard of hearing.
ex.zh: 我爺爺的聽力不太好。

ex.en: Listening to loud music every day can damage your hearing.
ex.zh: 每天聽很大聲的音樂可能會損害你的聽力。

hearing.en: the ability to notice sounds with your ears

ex.en: The court hearing has been moved to next Monday.
ex.zh: 法院的開庭審理改到下週一。

ex.en: The city held a public hearing about the new airport.
ex.zh: 市政府針對新機場舉辦了一場公聽會。

hearing.en: a meeting in a court where people give facts about a case

ex.en: The heroine of this story is a little girl.
ex.zh: 這個故事的女主角是一個小女孩。

ex.en: The novel ends with the heroine's death.
ex.zh: 小說以女主角的死作為結尾。

ex.en: The heroine of the drama falls in love with her neighbor.
ex.zh: 這部劇的女主角愛上了她的鄰居。

heroine.en: the main female character in a story or film

ex.en: You're my heroine.
ex.zh: 妳是我心目中的英雄。

ex.en: The nurse became a local heroine after saving the child.
ex.zh: 那位護理師救了孩子後成為當地的女英雄。

heroine.en: a woman who is admired for being brave or doing something great

ex.en: The headline caught my eye this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上那則頭條吸引了我的目光。

ex.en: The story made headlines around the world.
ex.zh: 這件事登上了全球各地的頭條。

headline.en: the title of a news story at the top of a page

ex.en: This ring is a family heirloom.
ex.zh: 這枚戒指是家傳的寶物。

ex.en: The watch has been passed down as an heirloom.
ex.zh: 這支錶當作傳家寶代代相傳。

heirloom.en: a valuable object that a family keeps for many years

ex.en: Ironbridge Gorge is a Unesco world heritage site.
ex.zh: 鐵橋峽谷是聯合國教科文組織的世界遺產。

ex.en: We must protect our cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 我們必須保護我們的文化遺產。

heritage.en: the history, traditions and buildings passed down from the past

ex.en: The equator divides the globe into two hemispheres.
ex.zh: 赤道把地球分成兩個半球。

ex.en: Japan is located in the Northern Hemisphere.
ex.zh: 日本位於北半球。

hemisphere.en: one half of the earth, such as the north or south half

ex.en: The company plans to reduce its headcount by 10%.
ex.zh: 公司計畫裁減一成人力。

ex.en: Let's do a quick headcount before the bus leaves.
ex.zh: 巴士出發前我們先快速點個人數。

headcount.en: the number of people who work for a company or are present

ex.en: The company moved its headquarters to Taipei.
ex.zh: 公司把總部遷到了台北。

ex.en: Please send the report to our headquarters.
ex.zh: 請把報告寄到我們總部。

headquarters.en: the main office of a company or organization

ex.en: Please find the completed application attached herewith for your review.
ex.zh: 隨函檢附填妥的申請表，請查閱。

ex.en: We submit herewith the receipts requested by the finance department.
ex.zh: 謹隨函檢送財務部要求的收據。

herewith.en: together with this letter or message, used in formal writing

ex.en: Do you mind helping me carry this box upstairs?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把這個箱子搬上樓嗎？

ex.en: I will help you as far as I can.
ex.zh: 我會盡可能幫你的。

help.en: to make it easier for someone to do something

ex.en: Help! Someone call the police!
ex.zh: 救命啊！快報警！

ex.en: Thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙。

help.en: the act of making things easier for someone, or a cry for aid

ex.en: A headhunter offered me a job at a bigger company.
ex.zh: 有個獵人頭幫我介紹了一家更大公司的工作。

ex.en: Many companies use headhunters to fill senior positions.
ex.zh: 很多公司透過獵人頭來找高階主管。

headhunter.en: a person whose job is to find skilled workers for companies

ex.en: Many people believe that good souls go to heaven.
ex.zh: 許多人相信善良的靈魂會上天堂。

ex.en: This ice cream tastes like heaven.
ex.zh: 這個冰淇淋吃起來像天堂一樣美味。

ex.en: I have a blister on my left heel.
ex.zh: 我的左腳跟起了水泡。

ex.en: She turned on her heel and left the room.
ex.zh: 她轉身離開了房間。

ex.en: She doesn't like to wear shoes with high heels.
ex.zh: 她不喜歡穿高跟鞋。

ex.en: The heel of my boot came off.
ex.zh: 我靴子的鞋跟掉了。

ex.en: The heating in our apartment doesn't work.
ex.zh: 我們公寓的暖氣壞了。

ex.en: Please turn the heating on, it's freezing in here.
ex.zh: 請把暖氣打開，這裡冷死了。

ex.en: Heating the milk too much will change its taste.
ex.zh: 把牛奶加熱過頭會改變味道。

ex.en: The heating of the metal made it expand slightly.
ex.zh: 金屬受熱後稍微膨脹了。

ex.en: She grows fresh herbs like basil and mint on the balcony.
ex.zh: 她在陽台上種了羅勒和薄荷等新鮮香草。

ex.en: Grandma uses a special herb to make tea for colds.
ex.zh: 奶奶用一種特別的草藥泡茶來治感冒。

ex.en: Add some herbs to the soup for better flavor.
ex.zh: 在湯裡加一些香草會更有味道。

ex.en: Write a clear heading at the top of each section.
ex.zh: 在每個段落的最上方寫一個清楚的標題。

ex.en: The heading of the article made everyone curious.
ex.zh: 這篇文章的標題引起了大家的好奇。

ex.en: The ship changed its heading to avoid the storm.
ex.zh: 為了避開暴風雨，船改變了航向。

ex.en: We checked the compass to confirm our heading.
ex.zh: 我們看羅盤來確認前進的方向。

ex.en: It took about three weeks for the cut to heal.
ex.zh: 這道傷口大約花了三個星期才癒合。

ex.en: Broken bones heal slowly as you get older.
ex.zh: 年紀越大，骨折癒合得越慢。

ex.en: Time can heal even the deepest sadness.
ex.zh: 時間能治癒再深的悲傷。

ex.en: The doctor used a special cream to heal the burn.
ex.zh: 醫生用一種特別的藥膏來治療燒燙傷。

ex.en: The headmaster welcomed the new students on the first day.
ex.zh: 開學第一天，校長歡迎新生。

ex.en: She wrote a letter to the headmaster about the problem.
ex.zh: 她寫了一封信給校長反映這個問題。

ex.en: I gave her a small gift for her birthday.
ex.zh: 我送了她一份小禮物當作生日禮物。

ex.en: She lost her wallet on the way home.
ex.zh: 她在回家的路上弄丟了她的錢包。

ex.en: Could you tell her that dinner is ready?
ex.zh: 可以告訴她晚餐準備好了嗎？

ex.en: She taught herself how to play the guitar.
ex.zh: 她自學了彈吉他。

ex.en: The teacher herself made all the cookies.
ex.zh: 老師親自做了所有的餅乾。

ex.en: My sister looked at herself in the mirror.
ex.zh: 我姊姊看著鏡子裡的自己。

ex.en: Henry is a common first name in English-speaking countries.
ex.zh: 亨利是英語系國家很常見的名字。

ex.en: Henry feeds the birds in the garden every morning.
ex.zh: 亨利每天早上都會餵花園裡的鳥。

ex.en: Our teacher asked Henry to share his answer.
ex.zh: 老師請亨利分享他的答案。

hey.zh: 嘿、喂（打招呼或引起注意）

ex.en: Hey, do you want to grab lunch with us?
ex.zh: 嘿，你要不要跟我們一起去吃午餐？

ex.en: Hey! You dropped your wallet on the floor.
ex.zh: 喂！你的皮夾掉在地上了。

ex.en: Hey, long time no see. How have you been?
ex.zh: 嘿，好久不見，你最近好嗎？

ex.en: Hello! How are you doing today?
ex.zh: 你好！你今天好嗎？

ex.en: She smiled and said hello to the new neighbor.
ex.zh: 她微笑著向新鄰居問好。

ex.en: Hello, this is Anna speaking. How can I help you?
ex.zh: 喂，我是安娜，請問有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

ex.en: He picked up the phone and said hello.
ex.zh: 他接起電話說了聲喂。

ex.en: Hello? Is anybody in the room?
ex.zh: 喂？房間裡有人嗎？

ex.en: Hello! I'm over here, near the front door.
ex.zh: 喂！我在這邊，靠近前門的地方。

ex.en: Helen volunteers at the animal shelter every Sunday.
ex.zh: 海倫每週日都到動物收容所當志工。

ex.en: I'm meeting Helen for coffee after work.
ex.zh: 我下班後要和海倫去喝咖啡。

ex.en: This umbrella isn't mine; I think it's hers.
ex.zh: 這把傘不是我的，我想是她的。

ex.en: My phone is old, but hers is brand new.
ex.zh: 我的手機很舊，但她的是全新的。

ex.en: Herbert has lived in this village all his life.
ex.zh: 赫伯特一輩子都住在這個村子裡。

ex.en: Herbert showed us how to plant tomatoes.
ex.zh: 赫伯特示範給我們看怎麼種番茄。

ex.en: The wound needs time for healing.
ex.zh: 傷口需要時間來癒合。

ex.en: Many people find walking in nature good for healing.
ex.zh: 許多人覺得在大自然中散步有助於療癒。

healing.zh: 有療癒效果的、有助痊癒的

ex.en: She drank a cup of healing herbal tea.
ex.zh: 她喝了一杯有療癒效果的草本茶。

ex.en: The doctor said this cream has healing properties.
ex.zh: 醫生說這種藥膏有助於傷口癒合。

ex.en: There is a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.
ex.zh: 地板上有一堆髒衣服。

ex.en: I have a heap of work to finish before Friday.
ex.zh: 我星期五前有一大堆工作要完成。

ex.en: She heaped rice onto his plate.
ex.zh: 她把飯堆滿他的盤子。

ex.en: Leaves were heaped against the fence after the wind.
ex.zh: 風吹過後，落葉堆在圍籬邊。

ex.en: We walked across the open heath covered with purple flowers.
ex.zh: 我們走過長滿紫色花朵的開闊荒原。

ex.en: Few trees grow on the windy heath.
ex.zh: 風大的荒原上幾乎沒有樹木生長。

ex.en: Heroin is a dangerous drug that causes strong addiction.
ex.zh: 海洛因是一種會導致嚴重成癮的危險毒品。

ex.en: The program helps people who are trying to stop using heroin.
ex.zh: 這個計畫幫助想戒除海洛因的人。

ex.en: The farm covers about fifty hectares of land.
ex.zh: 這座農場占地約五十公頃。

ex.en: One hectare is equal to ten thousand square meters.
ex.zh: 一公頃等於一萬平方公尺。

ex.en: The hen laid an egg in the corner of the barn.
ex.zh: 那隻母雞在穀倉的角落下了一顆蛋。

ex.en: My grandmother keeps a few hens in her backyard.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在後院養了幾隻母雞。

ex.en: A mother hen protects her chicks from danger.
ex.zh: 母雞會保護小雞不受危險威脅。

ex.en: The firefighter made a heroic effort to save the child.
ex.zh: 那位消防員奮力英勇地救出孩子。

ex.en: The town praised the heroic act of the young swimmer.
ex.zh: 小鎮稱讚那位年輕游泳者的英勇行為。

ex.en: It was a heroic decision to stay and help others.
ex.zh: 留下來幫助別人是個英勇的決定。

ex.en: The baby is completely helpless without his parents.
ex.zh: 沒有父母，這個嬰兒完全無法自理。

ex.en: She felt helpless as she watched the flood rise.
ex.zh: 看著洪水上漲，她感到無能為力。

ex.en: They heaved the heavy box onto the truck.
ex.zh: 他們費力地把重箱子抬上卡車。

ex.en: He heaved the rope with all his strength.
ex.zh: 他使盡全力拉那條繩子。

ex.en: The sea heaved under the small boat.
ex.zh: 海面在小船底下起伏翻騰。

ex.en: Her chest heaved as she tried to catch her breath.
ex.zh: 她胸口劇烈起伏，努力喘口氣。

ex.en: The page number appears in the header of each page.
ex.zh: 頁碼出現在每一頁的頁首。

ex.en: Please add your name to the email header.
ex.zh: 請把你的名字加進信件的標頭。

ex.en: He scored with a header from the corner kick.
ex.zh: 他用角球後的頭球得分。

ex.en: The goalkeeper stopped a powerful header.
ex.zh: 守門員擋下了一記強力頭球。

ex.en: They had a heated argument about who should pay the bill.
ex.zh: 他們為了誰該付帳而激烈爭吵。

ex.en: The meeting turned into a heated debate over the new schedule.
ex.zh: 會議變成了一場關於新時程的激烈辯論。

ex.en: We swam in a heated pool even though it was snowing outside.
ex.zh: 雖然外面下著雪，我們還是在溫水游泳池裡游泳。

ex.en: She wrapped her hands around a cup of heated milk.
ex.zh: 她雙手捧著一杯熱過的牛奶。

ex.en: He heated the soup on the stove for five minutes.
ex.zh: 他把湯放在爐子上加熱了五分鐘。

ex.en: The sun heated the sand until it was too hot to walk on.
ex.zh: 太陽把沙子曬得燙到無法行走。

ex.en: What the heck is going on here?
ex.zh: 這裡到底是怎麼回事？

ex.en: Oh heck, I forgot my keys again!
ex.zh: 糟了，我又忘了帶鑰匙！

ex.en: My little brother is a good helper in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是廚房裡的好幫手。

ex.en: The teacher chose two helpers to hand out the books.
ex.zh: 老師挑了兩位小幫手來發書。

ex.en: The first snow heralded the start of winter.
ex.zh: 初雪預告了冬天的到來。

ex.en: Newspapers heralded the new bridge as a great achievement.
ex.zh: 報紙將這座新橋譽為偉大的成就。

ex.en: The robin is a herald of spring in many places.
ex.zh: 在許多地方，知更鳥是春天的先兆。

ex.en: In old times, a herald announced the king's arrival.
ex.zh: 在古代，傳令官會宣布國王駕到。

ex.en: Purple heather covered the hills in late summer.
ex.zh: 夏末時，紫色的石南花開滿山丘。

ex.en: We walked through fields of heather in Scotland.
ex.zh: 我們走過蘇格蘭一片片石南花田。

ex.en: Heathrow is one of the busiest airports in Europe.
ex.zh: 希斯洛機場是歐洲最繁忙的機場之一。

ex.en: Our flight to London lands at Heathrow.
ex.zh: 我們飛往倫敦的班機會降落在希斯洛機場。

ex.en: Can I have a second helping of rice?
ex.zh: 我可以再來一份飯嗎？

ex.en: She gave him a generous helping of soup.
ex.zh: 她給了他滿滿一份湯。

ex.en: He is helping his neighbor move to a new apartment.
ex.zh: 他正在幫鄰居搬到新公寓。

ex.en: Thanks for helping me with my homework.
ex.zh: 謝謝你幫我寫功課。

ex.en: The news heightened our concerns about safety.
ex.zh: 這個消息加深了我們對安全的疑慮。

ex.en: Soft music can heighten the mood of a dinner.
ex.zh: 柔和的音樂能增添晚餐的氣氛。

ex.en: Tension heightened as the deadline approached.
ex.zh: 隨著截止日接近，緊張氣氛愈加升高。

ex.en: Their excitement heightened when the curtain rose.
ex.zh: 布幕升起時，他們的興奮感升高了。

ex.en: One headlight on my scooter stopped working.
ex.zh: 我機車的一邊車頭燈壞了。

ex.en: Turn on your headlights when it starts to rain.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時要打開車頭燈。

ex.en: I could hear my heartbeat after running up the stairs.
ex.zh: 跑上樓梯後，我聽得到自己的心跳聲。

ex.en: The nurse checked the baby's heartbeat.
ex.zh: 護理師檢查了寶寶的心跳。

ex.en: The airport is on heightened alert after the warning.
ex.zh: 警告發出後，機場進入了高度戒備狀態。

ex.en: She has a heightened sense of smell during pregnancy.
ex.zh: 她懷孕期間嗅覺變得更敏銳。

heightened.zh: （使）提高；加強（heighten 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The scary music heightened the tension in the movie.
ex.zh: 驚悚的音樂加強了電影裡的緊張感。

ex.en: Their visit heightened my interest in history.
ex.zh: 他們的拜訪提升了我對歷史的興趣。

ex.en: He carried a hefty bag of rice up the stairs.
ex.zh: 他扛著一大包沉重的米爬上樓梯。

ex.en: A hefty man stood guard at the gate.
ex.zh: 一個魁梧的男子在門口站崗。

ex.en: She had to pay a hefty fine for parking illegally.
ex.zh: 她因違規停車必須繳一大筆罰款。

ex.en: The company made a hefty profit last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年賺了一大筆利潤。

ex.en: The heavyweight raised both fists after the fight.
ex.zh: 那位重量級拳擊手在比賽後舉起雙拳。

ex.en: He trained for years to become a heavyweight champion.
ex.zh: 他訓練多年才成為重量級冠軍。

ex.en: She is a heavyweight boxer from a small town.
ex.zh: 她是來自小鎮的重量級拳擊手。

ex.en: The heavyweight title match sold out in an hour.
ex.zh: 重量級冠軍賽的票一小時就賣完了。

ex.en: The captain stood at the helm of the ship.
ex.zh: 船長站在船的舵旁。

ex.en: She took the helm and steered toward the harbor.
ex.zh: 她掌舵駛向港口。

ex.en: The new director is now at the helm of the company.
ex.zh: 新任主管現在執掌公司。

ex.en: Under her helm, the team grew quickly.
ex.zh: 在她的領導下，團隊快速成長。

hertfordshire.zh: 赫特福德郡（英格蘭東南部的郡）

ex.en: Hertfordshire is a county in the southeast of England.
ex.zh: 赫特福德郡是英格蘭東南部的一個郡。

ex.en: Many people who work in London live in Hertfordshire.
ex.zh: 許多在倫敦工作的人住在赫特福德郡。

ex.en: Some forms of heart disease are hereditary.
ex.zh: 某些心臟疾病是遺傳性的。

ex.en: The doctor asked if the condition was hereditary in her family.
ex.zh: 醫生問這種狀況在她家族中是否會遺傳。

ex.en: The country is ruled by a hereditary king.
ex.zh: 這個國家由世襲的國王統治。

ex.en: In some places, the title of chief is hereditary.
ex.zh: 在某些地方，首領的頭銜是世襲的。

ex.en: The cat was sleeping on the hearth in front of the fire.
ex.zh: 貓正睡在爐火前的壁爐地面上。

ex.en: The family gathered around the hearth on winter evenings.
ex.zh: 冬天的夜晚，一家人圍坐在爐邊。

ex.en: She drinks herbal tea before bed.
ex.zh: 她睡前會喝草本茶。

ex.en: The shop sells herbal remedies for colds.
ex.zh: 這家店販售治療感冒的草藥。

ex.en: You should heed the doctor's advice and rest.
ex.zh: 你應該聽從醫生的建議好好休息。

ex.en: Few drivers heeded the warning signs on the road.
ex.zh: 很少駕駛人留意路上的警告標誌。

ex.en: He paid no heed to the rain and kept walking.
ex.zh: 他不理會下雨，繼續往前走。

ex.en: Take heed of what your teacher says.
ex.zh: 要留心老師說的話。

ex.en: She is learning Hebrew to read old texts.
ex.zh: 她正在學希伯來語，以便閱讀古老的文獻。

ex.en: Modern Hebrew is the official language of Israel.
ex.zh: 現代希伯來語是以色列的官方語言之一。

ex.en: The museum has a Hebrew manuscript from long ago.
ex.zh: 博物館收藏了一份很久以前的希伯來手稿。

ex.en: He studied the Hebrew alphabet in school.
ex.zh: 他在學校學過希伯來字母。

ex.en: The stars are heavenly bodies we can see at night.
ex.zh: 星星是我們夜裡能看到的天體。

ex.en: Many people pray to a heavenly father.
ex.zh: 許多人向天父祈禱。

ex.en: This chocolate cake tastes heavenly.
ex.zh: 這塊巧克力蛋糕美味極了。

ex.en: We spent a heavenly week on a quiet island.
ex.zh: 我們在一座寧靜的小島上度過了美好的一週。

ex.en: The village healer used herbs to treat the sick.
ex.zh: 村裡的治療者用草藥為病人治病。

ex.en: Many people believe time is a great healer.
ex.zh: 許多人相信時間是最好的療癒者。

ex.en: Herring is often pickled or smoked in northern Europe.
ex.zh: 在北歐，鯡魚常被醃漬或燻製。

ex.en: We saw a school of herring swimming near the boat.
ex.zh: 我們看到一群鯡魚在船邊游過。
